newsitem.title: USA: Central Parking files 4.5 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Central Parking files 4.5 mln shr offering.

text.p: Central Parking Corp said Monday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with a public offering of 4,100,000 shares of common stock.
The company said it plans to offer 3,300,000 of the shares, and 800,000 shares will be offered by certain selling shareholders.
The company said it will also grant the underwriters an over-allotment option for an additional 410,000 shares.
J.C. Bradford & Co, William Blair & Co and Equitable Securities Corp will serve as managing underwriters of the offering, Central Parking said.
Proceeds to the company from the offering will be used to repay indebtedness, the company said.
